results.releaseNotes:
*iPhone Duo Support: Speed Tracker makes full use of the bigger screen when your iPhone Duo is open, with content side by side 
*Garage Widgets: Put your car on your Home Screen in small, medium, or large, with its distance, time saved, drive time, top speed, or trips for the period you choose
*More Cars in the Garage: Many new makes and models to choose from when you add your car 
*More Interactive Feedback: Sending feedback is now more interactive, so it's easier to tell us what you think 
*Performance Improvements: Bug fixes, reliability, and overall performance
results.description:
Enhance Your Driving Experience with Speed Tracker Speed Tracker is the ultimate app for car enthusiasts and drivers who want to monitor and analyze their driving with precision. Whether you're on a road trip, a weekend drive, or simply commuting, Speed Tracker provides the insights you need to understand every drive. All core features work out of the box - no account or subscription required.

Key Features:

Real-Time Driving Metrics: Track your current speed, average speed, and maximum speed in real-time. Monitor your journey with precise GPS location updates, even when the app is running in the background. Follow your trip from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with Live Activities, including distance, duration, average speed, and ETA status. Optionally auto-start trips when you begin driving and end them when you park - even if the app was closed.

Shortcuts, Widgets & Automation: Set up CarPlay automations to automatically track trips when you connect or disconnect from your car. Control tracking with Siri voice commands and Apple Shortcuts. Add Home Screen widgets for your last trip, distance, monthly distance, ETA comparison, and leaderboard standing.

In-Depth Trip Analysis: Access detailed summaries of each trip, including start and end times, total distance, and duration. Analyze your route with comprehensive speed data and GPS coordinates. Compare the route's estimated travel time with how long the drive actually took. Replay any trip on a full-screen map and export it as a GPX file. Create share cards from any trip - polished route, compact, or overlay graphics ready to send to friends or post online.

Interactive Map Visualizations: Visualize your routes on a dynamic map with speed-based coloring. Customize speed ranges for map coloring, or use Autobahn-optimized presets. See every road you've ever driven on the Roads Driven heatmap.

Your Profile: Add your cars to the Garage - every trip remembers the car it was driven with. Earn distance milestones for all your driving and for each car.

Comprehensive Driving Statistics: View detailed statistics on total distance, duration, average speed, and top speed. Explore your records, when you drive, your speed mix, your ETA record, streaks, and breakdowns by car and tag.

Trip History & Management: Browse through your trip history with advanced sorting and filtering options. Tag trips for better organization and quick access. Sync and back up your trips with iCloud for seamless access across all your devices.

Speed Tracker Social (subscription required): Share your trips with friends or drivers worldwide in a live feed. Watch friends - and drivers sharing worldwide - live on the map with real-time speed, route, and ETA. Auto-share completed drives with friends and get alerts when someone is driving live. React to shared trips, build your online profile, connect with friends, and explore their drives. Attach a car from your Garage when you share, and turn a photo of it into a custom car picture. Compare on global, country, and friends leaderboards in categories like distance, drive time, average pace, ETA comparison, and longest trip. Social features require a monthly or yearly subscription. All core tracking, analysis, and statistics features remain fully available without a subscription.

Why Choose Speed Tracker? It's built for drivers who want precise, detailed driving data - from road trips to daily commutes. With Live Activities, widgets, the Roads Driven map, and Speed Tracker Social, every drive is easy to follow, revisit, and share.

Download Speed Tracker today and take your driving experience to the next level!
